content: अनिष्ट {%a.%} .²1 Unwished, undesirable; unfavourable, disagreeable, ill (with <ab>gen.</ab>); ध्यायत्यनिष्टं यत्किञ्चित्पाणिग्राहस्य चेतसा <ls>Ms. 9. 21</ls> whatever ill she thinks of her husband. .²2 Evil, forbidden. .²3 Bad, unlucky, ominous. .²4 Not honoured with a sacrifice. .{@-ष्टम्@} An evil, mishap, misfortune, calamity, disadvantage; a crime, offence, wrong, unwelcome thing; ˚एकबुद्धि <ls>Māl. 8. 12</ls>; भवत्यनिष्टादपि नाम दुःसहान्मनस्विनीनां प्रतिपत्तिरीदृशी <ls>Ku. 5. 42</ls>; ill-omen; प्रातरेव ˚दर्शनं जातम् <ls>H. 1</ls>.
